title: Exposure route CPU (C1 rolled back)
question: Uncached EEM (first request after deploy) took 11 ms CPU and VXUS 12 ms, over the 10 ms Free limit; SPAB 8 ms and BNDX 5 ms passed; all outcomes ok. A (recommended): fix packet W1R3 finds and cuts the CPU (cold start, cache-copy of large bodies), adds a body-size cap, measures without production traffic if possible, then redeploy. B: accept and roll back only on real CPU errors (1102). C: lower the cap now (refuses VXUS) and redeploy.
